**Estimating Effort**

I am currently focused on breaking down the software increment into smaller, manageable tasks. My next step is to estimate the work-hours for each of these identified components, ensuring the final output adheres to the specified JSON schema.

**Refining Scope**

My focus has shifted to more granular aspects of the Spring XD/Batch/Hadoop ecosystem. I'm delving into user stories concerning Hadoop namenode configuration, optimizing `jdbchdfs` job performance, and addressing Spring Batch's execution context decoupling. Additionally, I'm exploring fixes for custom job module creation with Java Config and advancing the XD-on-Lattice/Diego PoC with pluggable SPI design.

**Detailing Task Requirements**

I'm now detailing the specific activities needed for each user story. This involves breaking down tasks like migrating wiki content, supporting Hadoop Namenode configuration in the DSL, and implementing passthrough mode for `jdbchdfs` batch jobs, all while estimating the required effort.

**Designing SPIs**

I am currently designing the pluggable container launcher and runtime SPI interface. My immediate next step involves implementing the Receptor API abstraction layer as a plugin and then refactoring the existing Lattice implementation against this new SPI.

technical_and_design_decisions: Adopt Markdown/AsciiDoc format for migrating wiki pages into the project repository under standard doc directories.
Extend Spring XD DSL configuration files to support default Hadoop Namenode URIs and related HA configurations.
Implement a dedicated passthrough tasklet/step in the jdbchdfs batch job to bypass chunk reader/writer overhead.
Decouple JobExecution and StepExecution context handling in Spring Batch to prevent ClassLoader and serialization leaks, then update Spring XD dependency and refactor existing workaround (XD-2486).
Enhance Spring XD module deployment logic to properly scan and instantiate Java Config-based custom batch job modules.
Design an abstract Runtime SPI layer for container orchestration in Spring XD, decoupling the Receptor API as a pluggable backend implementation.
Add shortDescription metadata field across all standard Spring XD module definitions and update doc generation scripts.
Extend the Shell processor module to retrieve Python script resources from HDFS URIs before launching execution in Cloud Foundry environments.
assumptions: A single developer will execute all implementation, refactoring, testing, and documentation activities.
A local or containerized Hadoop ecosystem and Cloud Foundry environment are available for integration testing.
Upstream Spring Batch changes required for U4 can be developed or integrated within the context of this work package.
Existing automated test suites and build scripts (Gradle/Maven) are operational and reusable.

activities.activity_description: Export current wiki content, convert formatting to standard documentation (AsciiDoc/Markdown), integrate into the main repository, and configure documentation tagging in the build pipeline.

activities.activity_name: U2: Hadoop Namenode Config Integration in DSL
activities.activity_description: Modify Spring XD DSL configuration loader to auto-wire Namenode properties from configuration files, eliminating manual configuration per DSL session.

activities.activity_name: U3: Passthrough jdbchdfs Batch Job Implementation
activities.activity_description: Create a passthrough batch step implementation for jdbchdfs job template to stream data directly without chunk-based read/write processing overhead.

activities.activity_name: U4: Execution Context Decoupling & Batch Workaround Refactoring
activities.activity_description: Refactor Spring Batch execution context lifecycle to avoid ClassLoader and serialization issues, upgrade Spring XD Batch dependency, and remove XD-2486 workaround.

activities.activity_name: U5: Custom Java Config Job Module Fix
activities.activity_description: Fix job module deployment scanner to recognize and register custom job archives defined via Java Config instead of XML configuration files.

activities.activity_name: U6: Pluggable Runtime SPI Design (Diego/Lattice PoC)
activities.activity_description: Architect a generic pluggable orchestration SPI interface for Spring XD, refactoring Diego/Lattice Receptor integration into a pluggable SPI implementation.

activities.activity_name: U7: Module Documentation Short Description Updates
activities.activity_description: Audit all existing module descriptors and documentation files to insert shortDescription fields across all module categories.

activities.activity_name: U8: HDFS Python Script Hosting for Shell Processor
activities.activity_description: Enhance XD shell processor module to fetch Python scripts hosted on HDFS dynamically before launching Py runtime on Cloud Foundry.
Perform comprehensive end-to-end testing, integration verification across all modules, and regression testing prior to completion.
